title: Claim Coordination Time on the Mold Remediation Work-Plan Visit
content:
Claims coordination bulletin: time the Mold Remediation supervisor spends on a claim file's requirements during the work-plan visit, read from the Insurance Claim Services claim file linked to the job.

When the claim file linked to the job names a public adjuster, the supervisor walks the site with the adjuster and the adjuster walk hours of 0.5 hours are added to the visit hours. When the linked claim file names no public adjuster and its billing arrangement requires a carrier program referral number, the program photo documentation hours of 0.25 hours are added. Every other job adds no claim-coordination hours.

| Linked Insurance Claim Services file | Hours added |
|---|---|
| Names a public adjuster | 0.5 (walk with the adjuster) |
| No public adjuster; arrangement requires a carrier program referral number | 0.25 (program photo documentation) |
| No public adjuster; no referral number required | None |
| No linked claim file | None |

A file that names a public adjuster adds the 0.5 adjuster walk hours whether or not its arrangement requires a referral number.
